blocks.html: The result of a search query.

types.name: hits
types.description: The documents matching the query, ordered by the query's sort or by relevance.

children.name: id
children.description:
The value of the index's primary key for this document. `query.search` uses
it to hydrate the rest of the entity through `query.graph`.

children.name: score
children.description:
The document's relevance score. Scales are provider-specific and not
comparable across providers.

children.name: document
children.description: The retrievable fields the search engine returned for this document.

children.name: highlights
children.description:
The highlighted fragments of the fields requested in the query's
`search_options.highlight`, keyed by field path.

types.name: facets
types.description: The computed facets, keyed by the field they were requested on.

children.name: type
children.description: The facet counts per distinct value of the field.

children.name: values
children.description: The distinct values of the field and how many documents hold each of them.

children.name: other_count
children.description:
The number of documents falling outside the returned values, where the
provider reports it.

children.name: ranges
children.description: The requested ranges and how many documents fall in each of them.

children.name: key
children.description: The range's key, as passed in the request.

children.name: from
children.description: The range's inclusive lower bound.

children.name: to
children.description: The range's exclusive upper bound.

children.name: count
children.description: The number of documents in the range.

children.name: min
children.description: The field's smallest value among the matching documents.

children.name: max
children.description: The field's largest value among the matching documents.

children.name: avg
children.description: The average of the field's values, where the provider reports it.

children.name: sum
children.description: The sum of the field's values, where the provider reports it.

children.name: count
children.description: The number of documents the aggregations were computed over.

types.name: metadata
types.description: The result's pagination and timing details.

children.name: skip
children.description: The number of documents skipped before the returned hits.

children.name: take
children.description: The maximum number of hits returned.

children.name: count
children.description:
Usually it's an estimate on the count, very few providers return an exact count.
If the user didn't ask for a count, it's `null`.

children.name: next_cursor
children.description:
The cursor to pass in the next query's pagination to retrieve the next page,
on providers that paginate with cursors.

children.name: query
children.description: The free-text query the result was computed for.

children.name: processing_time_ms
children.description: How long the search engine took to run the query, in milliseconds.

types.name: provider_metadata
types.description:
Extra details the provider returned, passed through verbatim. Nothing in
Medusa's core reads from this.
